 The General Directorate of Taxes (DGI) reminded taxpayers on Thursday in Rabat that several categories of taxpayers must file their returns and pay any amounts due no later than November 2, 2026. The deadline applies, in particular, to those with turnover exceeding 2 million dirhams, non-resident providers of remote services, and VAT-registered taxpayers.
 Legal entities and individuals whose turnover excluding VAT exceeds that threshold, for a financial year ending before January 1, 2026, must submit the quarterly payment-deadline return for the third quarter of 2026 and, where applicable, pay the required fine via «SIMPL-Délais de paiement». The statement of invoices not paid within the required deadlines must be certified by a statutory auditor where turnover reaches 50 million dirhams or more, or by a chartered accountant or certified accountant below that threshold.
 Non-resident providers supplying digital services to non-taxable customers in Morocco must declare their third-quarter turnover and pay the corresponding tax via «Taxation on digital services». Taxpayers subject to VAT under the quarterly regime must declare their turnover for Q3 2026, while those under the monthly regime must declare their turnover for September 2026 via «SIMPL-TVA».
